=== api .env DB ===
APP_ENV=local
APP_URL=http://localhost:3001
DB_CONNECTION=mysql
DB_HOST=database
DB_PORT=3306
DB_DATABASE=verein
DB_USERNAME=verein
DB_PASSWORD=verein
=== web .env.local ===
WEB_APPLICATION_URL=http://localhost:3000
WEBSITE_URL=http://vereinfacht.digital
API_DOMAIN=http://api
API_PATH=/api/v1
API_BEARER_TOKEN=<redacted>
NEXTAUTH_SECRET=non-production-secret
NEXTAUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000
ADMIN_LOGIN_PATHNAME="/admin/auth/login"
SIGNAL_INVITE_URL=https://google.de
SUPPORT_EMAIL_ADDRESS="hello@vereinfacht.digital"
SUPPORT_PHONE_NUMBER="0461 150653625"

observation.command: echo "=== api .env DB ==="; grep -E '^DB_|^APP_URL|^APP_ENV' /workspace/api/.env 2>&1; echo "=== web .env.local ==="; grep -vE '^\s*#|^\s*$' /workspace/web_application/.env.local 2>&1 | sed 's/\(TOKEN=\).*/\1<redacted>/'
